# pq-glue

> Concatenate Parquet files without decoding them.

pq-glue concatenates Parquet files that share a schema by copying their encoded row
groups into one file, without decoding them, from Python (`pq_glue.concat`) or Rust
(`pq_glue::concat`). Install with `pip install pq-glue`. Each link below is the Markdown
version of a page of https://lmmx.github.io/pq-glue/.

## Benchmarks

- [Benchmarks](<https://lmmx.github.io/pq-glue/pr-preview/pr-13/benchmarks/index.md>): Wall time, CPU time and peak memory of concatenating Parquet files with pq-glue, Polars and pyarrow, and how to reproduce them.

## Concepts

- [Concepts](<https://lmmx.github.io/pq-glue/pr-preview/pr-13/concepts/index.md>): How pq-glue concatenates Parquet files: row groups are copied as bytes, and only the footer is new.
- [What is copied](<https://lmmx.github.io/pq-glue/pr-preview/pr-13/concepts/copying/index.md>): The parts of the output file and their sources, the requirements on the inputs, and the cases concat refuses.
- [Column orders](<https://lmmx.github.io/pq-glue/pr-preview/pr-13/concepts/column-orders/index.md>): Why pq-glue rewrites the footer's column orders, so that copied float statistics stay readable.

## Get started

- [Installation](<https://lmmx.github.io/pq-glue/pr-preview/pr-13/getting-started/installation/index.md>): Install pq-glue from PyPI or crates.io.
- [Quickstart](<https://lmmx.github.io/pq-glue/pr-preview/pr-13/getting-started/quickstart/index.md>): Write two Parquet files with pyarrow, concatenate them with pq_glue.concat, and check the result.

- [History](<https://lmmx.github.io/pq-glue/pr-preview/pr-13/background/history/index.md>): pq-glue's development journal: where its dated entries are and what each one records.

## Reference

- [Reference](<https://lmmx.github.io/pq-glue/pr-preview/pr-13/reference/index.md>): pq-glue's API in Python and in Rust.
- [pq\_glue (Python)](<https://lmmx.github.io/pq-glue/pr-preview/pr-13/reference/api/pq_glue/index.md>): The pq_glue Python package: concat, concat_many, write_parquet and their errors.
- [pq-glue (Rust)](<https://lmmx.github.io/pq-glue/pr-preview/pr-13/reference/rust/index.md>): The pq-glue Rust crate: concat, concat_many, Error and the footer module.
